question: Which XMP forms are allowed for FOAF address records, and which mailbox formats are valid?
interim_boundary: Address fields use ordered arrays of structured FOAF Agents with required mbox and optional name/other FOAF fields. Preserve supported equivalent XMP struct forms and both XMP URI text and rdf:resource mailto encodings. Validate mailbox syntax against RFC addr-spec/mailto rules without fabricating addresses; non-SMTP tokens use exact raw fields. Unhandled legal encodings remain unavailable rather than proved mismatches.

why_it_matters: EA-PDF requires FOAF Agent records. It does not fully explain when to use typed structures, URI links or text, or which address syntax to reject.
